events.narration: Both kings are castled and every piece is out: a healthy start.
18...f5 prepares a central break. Hold that thought.

events.title: Keep the tension or break?
events.narration: This is the decision of the game. Your pieces are active, but the centre is closed and White has nothing to attack.

interaction.prompt: Which plan would you choose here?

options.label: Bring the last rook to the e-file and keep the tension

feedback.correct: Yes. Keeping the tension costs nothing, and your pieces get better every move.
feedback.reasonable: Playable, but it doesn't use your extra activity.
feedback.misses: Forcing it open now hands White the e4 square after the exchanges.

interaction.reveal: In the game you played 19...e4. After 20.dxe4 fxe4 21.Nxe4 the pawn falls: Nxe4 is the consequence, the break was the decision.

events.takeaway: Before a pawn break, check what the opened lines give your opponent.

events.narration: 21.Nxe4 collects the pawn. 19...e4 was a strong central break.

feedback.correct: Yes: Ng5 hits h7 and your queen is overloaded.
feedback.misses: Look at h7: Ng5 was the big chance.

interaction.reveal: White missed Ng5 and played 25.c5 instead.

interaction.prompt: Find the only move that keeps you in the game.
interaction.hint: Where is the bishop safe and still useful?

feedback.correct: Exactly: 25...Be7 keeps the bishop and covers your king.
feedback.reasonable: It saves the bishop, but leaves it passive.
feedback.misses: This loses more: the bishop needs a safe square that still defends.

events.narration: Queens come off. The ending is worse for you, but there is still play.
33...Re2+ is the start of active defence: your rook gets behind White's pawns instead of waiting.

interaction.prompt: Find the move that stops the pawn.

feedback.reasonable: Close, but the pawn is still dangerous.
feedback.misses: The pawn is one step from queening: your rook must get behind it now.

interaction.reveal: 38...Rc3 won the pawn on the next move.

events.narration: White repeats the position: a good practical result for you.
